node.content-desc: Up a folder: remove the keys

node.text: Choose the folders the music shows; subfolders are included. With none, it shows all the music the library has.

Local music files play through Nağmedar's own engine: the tracks of an album follow one another without a gap, the output can be bit-perfect, and the equaliser is its own. libVLC plays streams and everything else either way. Applies to the next track.
